items.title: Darboe Tells Mansaring Suu Women They Hold the Key to Healing Gambia’s Wounds
items.summary: By Seedy Jobe ANM Ousainu Darboe, leader of the United Democratic Party (UDP), has urged women in Mansaring Suu, Brikama, to take a leading role in bringing political change to The Gambia, saying they hold the power to address what he described as the country’s deepening econo...
